parameters.query:
select id, slug, title, summary, event_start_at, event_end_at, timezone, venue_name, neighborhood, category, price_text, source_url, image_url, tags
from public.events
where status = 'approved'
order by event_start_at asc;

parameters.command:
cat <<'EOF' > public/data/events/upcoming.json
{{ JSON.stringify({ generated_at: $json.generated_at, items: $json.upcoming }, null, 2) }}
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > public/data/events/archive.json
{{ JSON.stringify({ generated_at: $json.generated_at, items: $json.archive }, null, 2) }}
EOF

git add public/data/events/upcoming.json public/data/events/archive.json
git commit -m "chore: refresh event snapshot"
git push origin main
